body: Session cookies are issued for 12 hours. A timeout at sign-in usually means the token service is refusing new tokens, so check the token service first.
Nightly backups run at 01:00 and write to the archive bucket. Restores are manual and take about an hour.
Sign-in hung for twenty minutes. The token service had exhausted its connection pool. Raising the pool size cleared it and we added an alert on pool waits.
Deploys go out behind a flag. Roll back by flipping the flag, then drain the old pods.
New starters get an account on day one. Ask the platform team if sign-in does not work by lunchtime.
The primary accepts writes. A read replica lagging past 30 seconds will make a fresh sign-in look broken, because the session row is not visible yet.
